verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a tax agency's online service, which could offer batch filing or payments, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only edge-denial probes (HTTP 403 at robots.txt and at the MyFTB/Web Pay host) and no documentation of any bulk or batch capability, so the verdict is none.
